blocks.chat_scope: Three phases over 36 months. Phase 1 (months 0–12, govern + credentialing): ~$22M. Phase 2 (12–24, AI CoE goes live): ~$41M cumulative. Phase 3 (24–36, scale): ~$69M+ run-rate, ramping toward the full $144M+.
